name: Anticipation, Apprehension, Adolescence
source:
This is a story that takes place over the course of several years, starting as a preteen and ending in adulthood. The main character Laura often finds herself forced into situations by her friends, who seem to only be trying to help. Romance was never something she actively looked for, but she can't help but escape it as her friends take it upon themselves to help her find love. But are any of them really any better off then she is at this little game they call adolescence?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31733]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这是一个发生在几年内的故事，从青春期前开始，到成年结束。主角劳拉经常发现自己被朋友们逼入困境，而朋友们似乎只是想提供帮助。浪漫从来都不是她积极寻找的东西，但当她的朋友们主动帮助她找到爱情时，她情不自禁地逃避它。但他们中的任何人真的比她在这个他们称之为青春期的小游戏中过得更好吗？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31733]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
